Before you yell again… 🛑

Leah is six. She spills juice all over the brand new rug. In that second, she isn't looking at the mess. She's looking at your face, asking one question: "Am I safe with you?" 👀

If the answer is a yell, she learns to hide. The bad grade, the broken things, all hidden under the bed. 12 years later, she scratches the car… and the last person she wants to call is you. 💔

"I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid… and I hid myself." Genesis 3:10

But God didn't come yelling. He came looking. 🙏 "For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost." Luke 19:10

Rewind. ⏪ The juice spills. Mom takes one deep breath and says, "Are you okay?" and they clean it up together. ❤️ 12 years later, when Leah scratches the car, she isn't afraid to tell you.

You don't need to be a perfect parent. Your child needs a safe voice. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
